title: The Ordinary Undertow
author: Odile Voss
blurb: Sebastian Crane, a bridge inspector measuring the marriage in expansion joints, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. But when a childhood home goes up for auction, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must ask the question the whole family arranged itself around, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
